thread:
Laura Chen: Quick sync — Q3 telemetry UI roadmap. I sketched a reduced scope so we can hit a ship date: dashboards (team templates), error grouping, basic cost attribution, traces retention toggle as stretch. Need to pick MVP vs stretch and launch criteria.
Anand Iyer: Lean MVP makes sense. Dashboards + error grouping = biggest customer impact. Traces retention UI touches infra; riskier.
Sam Ortiz: Sales feedback: per-route cost visibility + CSV export are high priority for pilots. If lightweight, put those in MVP.
Maria Gomez: From PM: we need clear launch criteria — perf SLO for UI render (p95 < 200ms), UX test with 3 pilot customers, and integration with billing for cost attribution.
Olivia Park: Engineering note: retention toggle requires archive pipeline adjustments and index support. If we postpone that, we can reuse existing dashboard infra to accelerate.
Laura Chen: My proposed split: MVP = dashboards templates + error grouping + basic per-route cost column + CSV export. Stretch = retention UI, advanced cost slicing, built-in alerting. Thoughts?
Anand Iyer: Agree. Add a nonfunctional requirement: dashboard load under 2s for 90% of requests. We'll need caching + precompute for cost slices.
Sam Ortiz: For pilots, Sam can onboard 2 SaaS customers and one internal platform team. Need saved filters and shareable links to be available. Small UX but high value.
Maria Gomez: Can we set rollout plan and owners here? Also, OKR alignment: "telemetry adoption" metric should be weekly active dashboard users and "cost saved" via suggestions.
Laura Chen: Owners: Laura (product), Olivia (eng lead), Anand (backend), Sam (customer pilot), Maria (launch ops). Rollout: feature-flagged -> 10% internal -> 3 pilot customers -> GA.
deploy-bot: deploy 2026-08-12T03:21:10Z: feature/telemetry-ui deployed to staging :rocket:
Olivia Park: I'll post an engineering estimate by EOD Friday with dependencies (db migration, index builds, caching layer). Also will call out any hard blockers.
Laura Chen: Great — once estimates in, I'll build prioritization doc and proposed milestones for the Q3 roadmap. Please add any missing items or customer asks inline.
file_notes: thread focused on scope negotiation, owners, rollout plan and launch criteria for telemetry UI (dashboards, error grouping, retention).
